page.overview:
Who is Shinnok?

Shinnok, also known as The Fallen Elder God, is a character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. A vengeful, powerful Elder God of Death, he seeks death and destruction across all the realms. He serves as one of the three main antagonists of the franchise alongside Shang Tsung and Shao Kahn.

Shinnok made his debut in Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero as the main antagonist and the final boss, and first became playable in Mortal Kombat 4, in which he again served as the main antagonist and final boss.

Shinnok returned as a playable character and the final boss of Mortal Kombat X, serving as the main antagonist of the game's Story Mode.

Shinnok is one of the most evil beings in the entire Mortal Kombat universe. A vengeful and powerful fallen Elder God of Death, Shinnok appeared in Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero, Mortal Kombat 4/Mortal Kombat Gold, and Mortal Kombat X as the main antagonist and final boss. He also made an appearance in Mortal Kombat: Armageddon, seemingly leading the side of evil.
